propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts at lines 249–250 due to assertions using startswith() to check URL base_url against a hardcoded endpoint string.

The startswith() prefix check is too weak: a URL like https://fallback.test.evil.example/ would satisfy the assertion despite pointing to a different host, because the attacker-controlled suffix sits after the checked prefix.

The fix must compare the parsed URL origin (scheme and netloc from urlsplit) by exact equality rather than substring prefix, eliminating the CodeQL alert and making the test assertion semantically correct.
A single-source constant must be used for both the configured endpoint and the asserted value to prevent drift between what is built and what is checked.
